items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: whenever we ran into each other we used to play duets together

ctx.x: What was the audience response like? Did they like it?

Oh, yeah, yeah. Well I mean it was different, you know, ‘cause wasn’t nobody really doing that. Sam Most was playing, and Jerome Richardson was playing, but you know, nobody had really heard that really. Sam Most had done some things with, I forget who it was, one of the bands. It might have been Don Redman, I don’t know. Because we used to, whenever they would come to watch, and whenever we ran into each other we used to play duets together, you know, and things. But there really wasn’t too much of it around,…
We’ve been interested in seeing if we can give some of our students an idea of what it must have been like to live on the road, and you did a couple of different periods of it.
